zara_bench: Ran a cross-region quant profile sweep for the new 13B on H100/A100/L4 (us-west1, eu-central1, asia-east1). found some weird FP8 regressions on L4. :warning:
ana_ml: can you paste the numbers (p50/p99/throughput/quality delta) for seq512 batch1?
zara_bench: sure, pasted raw table below (seq=512, batch=1, prompts=1k). results normalized to FP16 baseline per GPU (latency = ms, throughput = tokens/s, quality = MRR delta %):
```
GPU,Region,Config,P50_ms,P99_ms,Throughput_tps,QualityDeltaPct
H100,us-west1,FP16,45,120,980,-
H100,us-west1,INT8,22,55,2050,-0.35
H100,us-west1,FP8,24,60,1860,-0.75
A100,eu-central1,FP16,62,150,760,-
A100,eu-central1,INT8,35,95,1380,-0.9
A100,eu-central1,FP8,40,110,1250,-1.6
L4,asia-east1,FP16,90,260,420,-
L4,asia-east1,INT8,48,140,840,-0.6
L4,asia-east1,FP8,110,320,330,-4.5
```
zara_bench: notes: H100 INT8 gives ~2.0x median speedup with sub-1% quality drop. A100 INT8 is useful but P99 jumps more. L4 FP8 is a clear no-go for production (big quality hit + P99 regressions).
nana_ml: do we know which kernels were used? could be kernel fallback causing the L4 FP8 slowness.
zara_bench: yes — run used runtime flags: `--kernel=flash-attn-v2 --quant=auto` but for L4 the runtime currently falls back to `triton-legacy` for FP8 (no native flash-attn/optimized kernel), causing both perf and numerical differences.
sam_infra: can you paste the exact command? want to reproduce in eu-central1.
zara_bench: command:```bash
./run_bench.sh --model redwood-13b --seq 512 --batch 1 --region us-west1,eu-central1,asia-east1 --gpus H100,A100,L4 --quant FP16,INT8,FP8 --kernel auto --iters 1000
```
mike_ops: noted for capacity planning: if we switch eu-central1 to INT8 for 13B, expect ~1.7x throughput increase but need to allocate buffer for P99 spikes (~+40ms). suggest raising per-GPU SLO headroom by 30% during peak APAC traffic. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
nana_ml: what's the recommended production profile then? H100 -> INT8 with flash-attn-v2; A100 -> INT8 but prefer triton-tuned kernels and cap concurrent streams to avoid P99; L4 -> BF16 only (no FP8), or keep FP16 but use KV-cache optimizations.
sam_infra: also: for L4 in asia-east1 we saw kernel compile failures on FP8 on ~10% of runs -> deploy-bot reported: `eval-bot: kernel-fallback event: fp8_triton_fallback at 2025-11-02T03:12:18Z` — need to patch runtime to avoid silent fallback.
zara_bench: added short perf/quality delta summary: H100(INT8) +2.1x median throughput vs FP16, P99 -54% latency, MRR -0.35%. A100(INT8) +1.8x median throughput, P99 -36% latency, MRR -0.9%. L4(FP8) -0.2x throughput (regression) and -4.5% MRR (bad).
nana_ml: how big is the eval set? are deltas statistically significant?
zara_bench: used 10k eval prompts drawn from production prompt buckets; bootstrapped CI for MRR: H100 INT8 delta -0.35% (95% CI ±0.08%), L4 FP8 -4.5% (95% CI ±0.6%) so it's not noise.
mike_ops: action items: 1) disable FP8 on L4 by default in region config; 2) add kernel-compat check in onboarding pipeline; 3) update capacity recommendations doc for APAC (+30% buffer).
sam_infra: I'll open infra ticket with region config changes.
nana_ml: for rollout: propose canary 5% traffic to H100 INT8 + flash-attn-v2, monitor MRR/eval-set and P99 for 48h, then expand. include auto-fallback to FP16 on quality regression >1%.
zara_bench: created quick grafana links (private): https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/quant/13b-regional — dashboards include p50/p99, tokens/s, eval-mrr, kernel-fallback rate.
eval-bot: autopost: bench run complete. summary artifact: s3://redwood-bench/13b/1773004567/results.tar.gz
ana_ml: thanks — i'm updating the model onboarding checklist to add a "kernel compatibility + quant smoke" step. good catch on L4 FP8. :thumbsup:
zara_bench: next step I'll re-run L4 with BF16+manual-flash-attn-emulation to confirm whether numeric error comes from kernel or quant scheme. will post numbers tomorrow.
